subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention, tracing & dashboard bundling
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@bluebird.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing pricing details

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — Bluebird's infra team was impressed with the ingestion and trace visualization. As we scope the POC, our procurement asked for a clear breakdown for the observability add-ons (retention beyond 30 days, tracing retention/ingestion, and the advanced dashboards pack). Can you send a simple pricing sheet and any contract levers we can use to get to a one-year committed price?

Two specifics:
- We expect ~12 TB/month of observability ingest now, growing to ~20 TB/mo by Q4.
- We want at least 9 months of searchable retention for traces and logs; 12 months would be ideal if the economics work.

Also, will Redwood provide SLA-backed retention guarantees if we commit? Procurement will want that in the SOW.

Thanks — can loop in our procurement lead if helpful.

— Sarah
Sarah Lim
Head of Platform, Bluebird AI

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@bluebird.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing pricing details

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and for the time last week. Attaching a concise worksheet that shows our common bundle options (see attachment: observability-pricing-worksheet.xlsx). Quick notes up front:

- Base hosted plan includes 30 days retention for logs and traces.
- Add-ons are priced by retained GB-month and tracing ingest; we provide a discount ladder for annual committed volume.
- SLA-backed retention is available as an uplift (adds an uptime/restore SLA and a contractual retention durability guarantee).

Marissa (cc'd) is our solutions lead for observability — she can validate the trace retention model and help size the ingestion profile. To make this concrete, can you confirm: expected average monthly ingest for the POC and target committed spend range for 12 months? With that I can map a discount path and a draft SLA term.

If you'd prefer, we can do a 30-minute alignment call this week.

Attachments: observability-pricing-worksheet.xlsx

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@bluebird.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing pricing details

Hi Ben — thanks. Quick answers:
- For the POC (Q2) we expect ~14 TB/mo ingest. Production (target go-live Q4) ~20 TB/mo.
- Target committed spend: we'd prefer <$120k/month or ~ $1.3M ARR for the bundle if we can get 12 months retention and a reasonable SLA.

Procurement would want a clause confirming retention durability and a remedy (credit) if data is lost or not returned within X hours. Is that something Redwood will put into a term sheet?

We have a call Friday 10am PT to align procurement + platform. Would love to include your SE to walk the SLA specifics.

Thanks,
— Sarah

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing pricing details

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Bluebird's ask. Key items: 14→20 TB/mo, wants 12 months searchable retention for traces/logs, target ~$1.3M ARR (sub-$120k/mo). Procurement insists on SLA-backed retention + remedy credits.

My thoughts: we can propose a tiered retention bundle: 30d baseline, 90/270/365-day tiers priced by retained GB-month with discounts for 12-month commit. Offer an "SLA uplift" as a % fee on top of the committed price for guaranteed restore windows and contractual credits. Looking for guidance on the discount depth to propose and whether we can set hard caps on restore liability.

Can you draft a short pricing play (numbers) and attach a brief term sheet for procurement to review? I'm meeting their procurement call Friday 10am PT — would be great to have a one-pager and the SLA-term-sheet.pdf to share.

— Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 12:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing pricing details

Ben / Marissa — draft proposal below (numbers are first-pass and intended as negotiation anchors):

Pricing model (examples):
- Logs & Traces retained GB-month: standard (30d) = included
- 90d tier: $0.75 / GB-month
- 270d tier: $0.60 / GB-month
- 365d tier: $0.45 / GB-month

Tracing ingest surcharge: $0.10 / ingested GB (applies to tracing heavy workloads)

Discounting / commitments:
- 0% discount for month-to-month
- 10% discount on retained GB-month price for 12-month commit >= $500k ARR
- 20% discount for 12-month commit >= $1.0M ARR
- Additional 5% concession available for multi-year (2-year) commitment or prepayment

SLA uplift (optional add-on):
- Adds contractual retention durability guarantee and 24-72 hour restore SLA. Price = +6% of committed monthly $ for the SLA-backed retention guarantee.
- Remedy: service credits up to 30% of monthly committed fee for material retention failure; liability capped at committed fees.

Bundling guidance:
- Advanced dashboards pack (visualizations, custom metrics, cross-workspace joins) = $12k / month as an add-on, can be included in committed ARR for discount thresholds.
- If Bluebird includes the dashboards pack in the commit, move them into the 20% discount band at $1.0M ARR synthetic example.

Next steps:
1) I attached a one-page SLA-term-sheet.pdf that we can hand to procurement (redlines expected).
2) Ben: lead Friday call; propose our 12-month @ $1.15M ARR scenario with 20% discount floor plus SLA uplift at +6% — that puts committed monthly ~$85k after discount but add SLA uplift to final.
3) If they push for deeper discount, propose a staged ramp (year-1 commit + year-2 lower rate) or consumption collars.

I'll sync w/ legal on tightenings around restore liability (we prefer cap at committed fees).

-Karthik
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SLA-term-sheet.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@bluebird.ai>, Carlos Mejia <carlos@terrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing pricing details — Redwood proposal

Sarah / Carlos — thanks for the call Friday. Per the discussion, attached are the two artifacts we agreed you'd get: a concise pricing worksheet (observability-pricing-worksheet.xlsx) and a short SLA term sheet (SLA-term-sheet.pdf). Summary of the proposal and negotiation levers below: 

Proposal (example commit):
- 12 month committed ARR: $1,150,000 (average monthly committed ~ $95,833)
- Retention tier: 365d searchable for logs & traces at $0.45 / GB-month pre-discount
- Effective retained cost after 20% commit discount: $0.36 / GB-month
- Tracing ingest surcharge: $0.10 / ingested GB
- Advanced dashboards pack included as part of commit (value $12k/mo) to qualify for discount band
- SLA uplift (optional): +6% of monthly committed fee for SLA-backed retention guarantee (24-72 hour restore window, contractual credits up to 30% of that month's committed fee if retention failure)

Negotiation levers we discussed:
- Increase commit to hit the $1.3M band for an additional discount (we can explore 22–25% at $1.3M+).
- Move to 2-year committed arrangement or prepayment to get an extra 5% concession.
- Add consumption collars to protect both sides during ramp.

Next steps:
1) Review the attached SLA-term-sheet.pdf and mark up procurementable items; our legal is ready to engage on a few standard redlines.
2) If the numbers above look reasonable, I'll send a DocuSign for an AMD/MSA addendum and a payment schedule.
3) Marissa can run a quick trace retention test with your infra team next week to validate performance.

DocuSign (draft MSA addendum): https://app.redwood.redwood/docusign/AMD-7890123 (placeholder)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/7890123

Attachments: observability-pricing-worksheet.xlsx, SLA-term-sheet.pdf

Looking forward to the markup — happy to jump on another call to walk procurement through the SLA clauses.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
